items.title: UK mattress scheme’s recycling milestone and AstraZeneca’s fleet electrification: The sustainability success stories of the week
items.summary: As part of our Mission Possible campaign, edie delivers this member-exclusive weekly round-up of five of the best sustainable business success stories of the week.

In numbers: How the UK’s energy mix is changing
items.summary: For the second year in a row, renewables accounted for over half of the UK's energy mix, with fossil fuels making up less than a third of total generation according to new figures from the Government.

items.title: Tesco, Danone and WWF join calls for PM to back ‘Good Food Billl’
items.summary: More than 100 organisations have signed a letter to the Prime Minister (PM) calling for a ‘Good Food Bill’ to increase national food security and improve health, with signatories including Tesco, Sainsbury’s, Aldi and Waitrose.

items.title: SBTi launches consultation to shape revised FLAG Standard
items.summary: The Science Based Targets initiative (SBTi) has issued a call for industry feedback as it looks to update its Forest, Land and Agriculture (FLAG) Standard.

items.title: Schneider Electric Acquires Grid Resilience Solutions Provider AiDASH for $350 Million
items.summary: Global energy technology company Schneider Electric announced that it has acquired satellite data and AI-powered risk intelligence provider AiDASH, in a transaction valuing the company at an enterprise value of $350 million.

items.title: Thermal Battery Provider Antora Raises $550 Million to Power Industry, Data Centers
items.summary: Energy Transition / Private Equity & Venture Capital Energy storage company Antora Energy announced that it has raised $550 million in a Series C funding round, with proceeds aimed at expanding production of its thermal battery technology and accelerating large-scale deployment across the U.S. Founded in 2017, California-based Antora Energy provides thermal batteries that convert low-cost, intermittent renewable electricity into reliable industrial energy.

items.title: Commonwealth Raises $1 Billion to Accelerate Path to Commercial Fusion Energy
items.summary: Energy Transition / Private Equity & Venture Capital Commonwealth Fusion Energy (CFS) announced that it has raised $1 billion in equity funding in a new financing round aimed at accelerating its progress towards commercialization of its fusion energy technology, with the company targeting putting power on the grid in the early 2030s.
